semantic.justification: Consumed native HTML ID/class/inline-style order and deferred point bookmark production use actual CSS maps, property info, parser contexts, filter-private SfxStringItem/HTMLAttr and the real mark owner. No-head/table pending ownership, raw positions, queue-dependent duplicate handling and no-HREF named-anchor reserved target filtering are preserved. Consumed UTF8 Unambiguous decoding is source-derived, not a host URL substitute. Actual parser, Markdown/Worker and RTF tests cover this profile. General HREF URL/SmartRel2Abs, macro/footnote targets, division/section IDs and language/direction producers remain open; no whole-module or compiled upstream promotion. Native represented HREF branch now resolves nonempty destinations with original URIHelper::SmartRel2Abs(INetURLObject(base),href,null,false), uses original medium parent for an empty HREF, calls SetATagStyles, creates actual SwFormatINetFormat URL/target/name values and inserts through the pINetFormat head/context. HREF presence is distinct from URL validity, retaining empty native items rather than creating name bookmarks. Source first-option precedence, reserved-name filtering, script-class admission and prior-anchor closure remain intact. Macro events, foot/endnotes and positioned fields are outside the represented model; native LANG/direction option producers remain pending and no full raw-HTML/filter parity is claimed.
